releaseNotes: Subtitle fixes for series: when a subtitle file covers a whole season, the app now picks the episode you are actually watching instead of the first one, and files in a format it cannot open are reported clearly instead of failing oddly. Includes 1.4.62: subtitles are now found by the title's own id rather than its name (a Spanish name returned thousands of wrong results or none at all), a second subtitle site has been added, watched ticks agree with your phone, hold a movie poster to mark it watched, and the app re-syncs whenever you come back to it. Update from Settings - Check for Updates.
